title: Iranians rally and burn flags in Tehran on embassy takeover anniversary

tea.why: Demonstrators marked the 47th anniversary of the 1979 takeover of the U.S. Embassy in Tehran amidst heightened military tensions.
tea.want: Participants expressed hostility toward the United States and Israel, denouncing foreign policies.
tea.changed: Nov 4, 2026: Thousands rallied across Iran and outside the former U.S. Embassy in Tehran, burning flags and chanting slogans.

summary: On November 4, 2026, thousands of demonstrators participated in rallies across Iran, including a major gathering outside the former U.S. Embassy in Tehran, to mark the 47th anniversary of the 1979 embassy seizure. According to sources, participants burned American and Israeli flags, displayed warning banners targeting the U.S. President, and chanted anti-U.S. slogans. The annual event, known as the National Day of the Fight Against Global Imperialism, commemorates the historic storming of the embassy by students. The demonstrations coincided with elevated regional tensions and warnings from Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps regarding potential retaliation against American and Israeli interests. No official government counter-response or police intervention was reported in the texts.
demands: Oppose global imperialism and foreign policies of the United States and Israel
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: Thousands participated in demonstrations across Iran

updates.text: Demonstrators gathered outside the former U.S. Embassy in Tehran and across Iran to mark the 1979 takeover anniversary.
